verses.1: And so it happened that in the last days, times of chaos and disorder would arise.
verses.2: For people will become fond of each other, they will be friendly and generous, arrogant, proud, deceitful, and unwilling to obey their parents. They will also be rude and disobedient.
verses.3: Evil ones, sinners, devils, ungrateful ones, unfaithful ones.
verses.4: Fraudsters, deceivers, those who are deceived and trapped, more like enemies than friends.
verses.5: They refuse to have the power of piety within them; they deny its existence. And I will reject such people.
verses.6: For it is from these that those who commit sins against their wives and enslave them are brought into captivity. They indulge in various kinds of desires.
verses.7: We always learn, but never are we able to come to a true understanding.
verses.8: In a similar manner, Janus and Iambre also opposed Moises. In the same way, they too will be defeated in reality. They are people who have lost their mind, and they are unfit for any kind of faith.
verses.9: But they won’t stop for long, for their foolishness will be obvious to everyone, just as it happened with them.
verses.10: And you, by your teachings, your guidance, your commitment, your faithfulness, your patience, and your love, have accompanied me along the way.
verses.11: To those who were persecuted, to those who suffered hardships, like the ones I experienced in Antioch, Ikonium, and Lysistra… Those who were persecuted, I endured them myself. And from all of them, the Lord took me away.
verses.12: And all those who wish to live in righteousness in Christ Jesus will be rejected.
verses.13: But those evil people and deceivers will stop people from doing what they should do, leading them astray and causing them to be deceived.
verses.14: But you, who have learned and come back, know from whom you have learned.
verses.15: And since you have known the sacred letters from birth, use them to be wise for salvation through faith in Jesus Christ.
verses.16: Every writing is inspired by God and useful for teaching, for guidance, for correction, and for the education of children in justice.
verses.17: That the man of God may be a righteous one, and that he may engage in all good deeds.
